meta.title: What's new in Stormlog
meta.description: Rollup summaries for long-running sessions, correlated investigation views, and improved JAX edge-case handling.

updates.title: Summarize long-running monitor sessions
updates.summary: Multi-hour profiling jobs now roll up telemetry into periodic snapshots, reducing memory overhead and making it easier to spot memory growth patterns without drowning in raw samples.
highlights: Automatic telemetry rollup sidecars for multi-hour monitor sessions
Configurable rollup windows to balance detail and storage
Peak memory, allocation rate, and fragmentation trends across the entire run

updates.title: Correlated investigation views
updates.summary: Cross-reference memory allocations, device operations, and telemetry events to understand causality. Improved correlation handling surfaces the chain of allocation → peak → OOM.
highlights: Trace allocations across memory pool, device, and host boundaries
Correlate kernel dispatch with memory pressure for inference and training
Enhanced sidecar indexing for sub-millisecond latency on large datasets

updates.title: JAX profiling edge cases fixed
updates.summary: Resolved corner cases in XLA allocation tracking and expanded test coverage for jit, pmap, and multi-device sharding scenarios.
highlights: Fixed XLA buffer pool tracking under dynamic shapes
Improved multi-device correlation for jax.pmap and jax.sharding
Expanded test coverage for async dispatch and OOM flight recorder
updates.code:
from stormlog.jax import JAXMemoryProfiler

profiler = JAXMemoryProfiler()
with profiler.profile_context("dynamic_shapes"):
    # Now handles dynamic shapes and sharded arrays correctly
    y = jax.pmap(fn)(x)
results = profiler.get_results()
